narrative.overview: The page is a printed visitor pass for a building where web development and SAP SuccessFactors work side by side: ink on paper, four saturated zone colours, and a pass hanging from a black strap at a slight tilt. The feel is loud, tactile, honest. Every element is a boxed object with a hard edge and a physical offset shadow; nothing is soft, blurred or gradient-lit. Hierarchy comes from scale, ink fills and colour blocks, not greys.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground with ink borders, text and shadows
Zero-blur offset shadows that grow on hover and collapse on press
Four zone colours used as solid blocks
One condensed typeface, uppercase for labels

rules.name: The Ink-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are solid ink (or Reporting Blue on the current nav item). Never coloured or translucent.

rules.name: The Zone Colour Rule
rules.body: The four zone colours belong to the four zones and their matching certifications only.

rules.name: The No-Grey Rule
rules.body: No grey text tiers; secondary information is smaller or lighter in weight.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Anything that labels, navigates or acts is uppercase at 800–900 with positive tracking.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Pressable objects lift 1–2px on hover with a larger shadow and sink into it on press; 0.12s ease-out; off under reduced motion.

dos: Do give every new container a 3px ink border and a zero-blur ink shadow from the vocabulary.
Do keep zone colours tied to their zones.
Do set labels, buttons and nav in uppercase 800–900 with positive tracking.
Do follow the Press Rule with a reduced-motion fallback.
Do always show the full name, Evan Kline Mores, and keep the email assembled in the browser.
Do theme focus with the 3px Reporting Blue outline.
donts: Don't add rounded corners, gradients, blur, glass, or soft and coloured shadows.
Don't tilt anything other than the hanging pass.
Don't invent client logos, metrics, testimonials, or a photo slot.
Don't bring back the dark Graphite & Teal palette.
